name: Veilcanopy Shelter
description: A light, foldable woodland shelter of barkcloth, resin-thread, and flexible Silverbark Ash spars, made for quiet camp in the deep forest. Its sloped canopy sheds rain, breaks up silhouette, and channels morning dew into a fitted catch-pouch sized for a full day's drinking water.
narrative_effects: Counts as adequate weather shelter for one person and a bonded animal in temperate-to-cool conditions.
Visually breaks up silhouette under canopy; supports concealed-camp narration in forested terrain.
Morning dew catch yields water equivalent to a full waterskin under typical Feywood conditions; substitutes for a waterskin refill on consecutive forest mornings.
